card: Chat commands open per state and every decline says why, not silence
deviations_from_card: Two commits, not three: the StateRules field cannot land without the daemon catalog (no-`..` destructuring) and so the types field + contract regen, so (2)+(3) are one commit per the brief's one-commit-with-callers rule. Coupled files outside the write set: packages/stage-kit/src/generated/ballot-vectors.json (generated golden, regenerated with UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 via ballot_vectors test; it gains the new 'ignored' events, stage-kit's reducer lets them through, stage-kit tests green), packages/contract/src/generated/results/SegmentTables.js (generator output; validators.js unchanged), apps/console/src/pages/segments/layer2.test.tsx (pinned per-state row text). Commit 1 (red tests) was not rustfmt-clean on one assert; commit 2 fixes it. Case 7's table test did not compile before (new allows_command_in API), so it stayed uncommitted until commit 2; its foreign_command assert_ne is red on the old toml.
notes: command_gate rule order: command_not_in_segment, command_closed_in_state, then per-command (vote: no_open_poll, unknown_option; summon: unknown_foil, foil_vote_not_open). unknown_foil moved into the gate (same rule, same event). Per-viewer checks (poll_min_rank, propose_min_rank, unknown_hex) stay at the command. Decline events carry only msg_id + rule + action 'ignored', as before. Summary 'declined lately' line is counts per (command, reason) over 60 s, omitted when signed off. names.ts also labels unknown_foil and poll_min_rank under Show mechanics (they fell through to 'Chat filters'). Shared-surface lock taken and released. seg-01.toml commands line sits after screens because invalid_screens_rejected pins the allowed_ops/screens text block. Console bundle within budget, no budget change.
